subject: Request: 90-day forensic log window + SIG evidence (HelixCare)
messages:
From: Sarah Cho <sarah.cho@helixcare.com>
To: rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.example.com>
Cc: Paul Tan <paul.tan@helixcare.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: 90-day retention for audit/logging + SIG evidence

Hi Rishi,

Quick one from our security team as we progress toward contract sign: HelixCare requires a 90-day window for raw request/response logs and KV cache artifacts for forensics (in addition to the standard 30-day retention Redwood publishes).

We filled out the SIG and attached the questionnaire; we also need a sample of the log export format and a statement on how Redwood enforces deletion once the window expires. Can you confirm whether this is possible in the hosted plan or whether we need a Dedicated/Private deployment? If an exception is available, what evidence and contractual language do you need?

Thanks — appreciate a short summary we can share with our CIS and procurement teams.

—Sarah
Sarah Cho
Director, Information Security
HelixCare

Attachment: Helix_SIG_questionnaire_filled.pdf
From: rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.example.com>
To: Sarah Cho <sarah.cho@helixcare.com>
Cc: Paul Tan <paul.tan@helixcare.com>, kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwood.example.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: 90-day retention for audit/logging + SIG evidence

Sarah — thanks, forwarding to our security and legal leads to confirm options and evidence. Initial notes:

- Hosted API: standard logs are ephemeral (30d). We can provide exported samples and SIG responses, but extending retention to 90d for hosted customers is an exception and requires an architecture review and contract amendment.
- Dedicated/Private: these deployments can support longer windows via configuration and contractual terms (we'll need to capture exact storage/availability commitments).

I'll loop in Kimberly and Priya with a short summary and proposed next steps so we can give you concrete options and an evidence pack (sample export + retention matrix).

Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
From: rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.example.com>
To: kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwood.example.com>, priya_natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.example.com>, marcus_lin <marcus.lin@redwood.example.com>, evelyn_hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.example.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 10:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: HelixCare request — 90d forensic window (need security/legal ops)

Team — forwarding HelixCare's ask. High level: customer wants 90-day raw logs (requests/responses + KV cache artifacts) for forensics. They attached a partially completed SIG.

Questions / asks:
1) Security: can we produce a sample log export and a short operational statement on deletion/secure erasure that we can share? (Marcus — can you confirm format and whether sample_log_export.jsonl in the attachments matches our current export?)
2) Legal/Compliance: what contract language and sign-offs do we need to permit a 90d retention for a hosted customer? Is an addendum + SOC2 evidence sufficient or do we require Dedicated/Private?
3) Ops: if we approve this, what costs / provisioning work are involved (storage, retention SLA, retention_matrix_v2.csv)?

Please reply with brief bullets; Sarah wants a one-page summary for CIS and procurement. Looping Evelyn for customer success coordination.

Thanks — Rishi
From: marcus_lin <marcus.lin@redwood.example.com>
To: rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotrah@redwood.example.com>, kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwood.example.com>, priya_natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.example.com>, evelyn_hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.example.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: HelixCare request — 90d forensic window (need security/legal ops)

Rishi / team — quick tech notes:  
- Sample format: our log export is newline-delimited JSON (JSONL) with tokenized timestamps, request headers, response durations, and optional KV cache deltas. I've attached a small redacted sample (sample_log_export.jsonl).
- Hosted constraints: the hosted control plane currently enforces a rolling 30d TTL for raw logs to limit storage exposure; extending to 90d for a hosted tenant is not standard and requires a signed exception, additional storage allocation, and explicit retention/erasure automation.
- Dedicated/private: fully supported — retention is configurable and handled by customer-specific retention policies on the infra side.

Estimate: 90d retention for HelixCare's projected volume (~200GB/mo) — add ~12TB/yr of storage and a one-time configuration + compliance validation (approx 2–3 weeks ops work).

Marcus
Sr. Security Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachment: sample_log_export.jsonl
From: kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwood.example.com>
To: rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.example.com>, marcus_lin <marcus.lin@redwood.example.com>, priya_natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.example.com>, evelyn_hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.example.com>
Date: Wed, 26 Aug 2026 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: HelixCare request — compliance/contract guidance

Hi all — legal/compliance summary:  
- Policy: Our SOC 2 scope documents retention matrices and we publish a 30d default for hosted. For a customer-specific 90d requirement we need:  
  * A signed contract amendment (retention addendum) that specifies the retention window and the data types covered (requests, responses, KV cache).
  * A risk acceptance from our InfoSec lead (Marcus) and a technical runbook for secure deletion at the 90d mark.
  * Confirmation of jurisdiction and any cross-border data handling implications (HelixCare is US-based; verify no EU data residency flags).
- Evidence we can provide: SOC 2 controls mapping, redacted sample exports, and an attestation to the deletion workflow (ops runbook). We cannot provide raw customer logs to any third party — only HelixCare staff or legal proxies.

Next steps for sales: Draft a short one-page summary including: proposed retention window, costs estimate, required contract language (I can draft the addendum), and a list of deliverables (sample export, retention matrix, attestation). Once HelixCare signs the addendum and we obtain InfoSec approval, we can schedule the ops work.

Kimberly Park
Head of Legal, Redwood Inference
From: rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.example.com>
To: Sarah Cho <sarah.cho@helixcare.com>, Paul Tan <paul.tan@helixcare.com>, procurement@helixcare.com
Cc: kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwood.example.com>, priya_natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.example.com>, marcus_lin <marcus.lin@redwood.example.com>, evelyn_hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.example.com>
Date: Thu, 02 Sep 2026 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: 90-day forensic log window + SIG evidence (HelixCare)

Hi Sarah / Paul — thanks for the questionnaire. Per our internal review here is the concise plan we can share with your CIS and procurement:  

Summary: Redwood can support a 90-day forensic log window for HelixCare, but it requires a customer-specific retention addendum and InfoSec sign-off. Hosted customers can be granted the exception, however the change carries storage and operational costs and a short validation period.

Deliverables we will provide after signature:  
- Redacted sample export (attached: sample_log_export.jsonl)
- Retention matrix mapping (attached: retention_matrix_v2.csv)
- SOC 2 controls mapping and SIG answers (see attached Helix_SIG_questionnaire_filled.pdf + supplemental notes in Drive)
- An ops runbook describing secure erasure at day 91 and audit steps (attestation).

Estimated timeline & cost:  
- Contract addendum preparation: 3 business days.
- InfoSec review & approval: 5–7 business days.
- Ops provisioning + validation: 10–15 business days after approval.
- One-time provisioning fee: estimated (to be finalized) — we expect a storage and engineering allocation charge; we will propose a number in the addendum.

Next steps for HelixCare:  
1) Please confirm you want the hosted exception (we will propose the addendum) or if you prefer Dedicated/Private (we can give an alternative quote).
2) If hosted exception is okay, sign the DocuSign addendum (we will send it) and provide the final list of HelixCare staff who should receive exported logs.

References / Links: https://drive.redwood.example.com/HelixCare/SIG-pack (full SIG + supplemental notes).

Thanks — I will have Kimberly draft the addendum and Priya loop in procurement guidance. Happy to jump on a 30-min call if that helps.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachments: retention_matrix_v2.csv; sample_log_export.jsonl
